description: Hyperview is a cloud-based (software as a service) data centre infrastructure management platform. Its features cover asset management with automated discovery, capacity planning, energy management, environmental monitoring, power monitoring and outlet control, catalogue and firmware management, with dashboards showing power use, rack capacity and cooling efficiency across several sites. A June 2025 blog post by its chief marketing officer, Rajan Sodhi, argues that SaaS DCIM is quicker to deploy and cheaper to scale than on-premises tools, and claims AI-based predictive analytics that reduce unplanned outages by 25 per cent. Hyperview publishes developer documentation, an open REST API with a changelog and a GitHub presence, and pre-built integrations such as ServiceNow and a white paper on integrating Equinix colocation data. Coverage: any data centre, colocation or edge site. Format and access: commercial subscription with published pricing and a free trial. Caveats: proprietary; claims such as the outage reduction come from marketing material. Simulation uses: live asset, power and environmental data for data centre digital twins and capacity planning, and inputs for studies of cooling and power failure effects. Related records: Sunbird DCIM, Nlyte DCIM and Schneider EcoStruxure IT are comparable products.
